findings.text: The negative-control paragraph says the square-arm control holds "qualitatively" and explains the 56-versus-2 count as the Schur complement being "taken over the 128 coil arms rather than reduced to the fourteen coil channels first", but the receipt it cites (logs/negative-control.log) records the reduced arm at reduced_negative_count 0 with reduced_min_eigenvalue_h exactly 0.0 over 2 populated channels of 14, so the reduction was taken and is degenerate -- a zero from 12 structurally empty channels read as the absence of the defect. Neither arm reproduces the two negative eigenvalues the brief's literal negative control declares, and the attribution that the square geometry caused the indefiniteness is therefore unproven by this run, though the plan accepts the refusal on other measurements.

The gate paragraph states that seven files were run at the repaired head and that each log ends with its bare exit status, but logs/gate-r3-head-test_coupled_plant.log ends after nine tests with no EXIT= line, so the head arm of tests/test_coupled_plant.py never completed and the base red tests/test_coupled_plant.py::test_real_sectioned_set_reduction_is_within_one_percent is unverified at head. The manifest records after_suite completed:false accurately; the fragment's receipt sentence overstates it.

A new 247-line module was added outside the brief's write list, which grants docs/figures/iter-passive-plasma-circuit/vs3-jacket-positive-linkage.svg only; it also carries its own save_checked/check_text clipping-and-overlap gate for which nova/media and nova/graphics have no owner, so the addition is defensible but lies outside the declared fence and is disclosed only in the manifest's follow_ons.

test_repaired_keys_are_pinned_where_the_retired_ones_were asserts only that each derived key appears as a substring in three files, so it passes for a file that merely mentions the key and does not show the pin moved; the retired-digest half of the same claim (test_retired_digests_are_gone_from_the_tree at line 304) is a real search and does read the tree.

Done-when (1)'s 6 mm half is unmet: the 6 mm entry stores 40 negative eigenvalues with a smallest value of -4.009411e-08 H, independently re-measured from scratch/cache/f3a24fdd12eae6348f3a/linkage.npy, and its five arms are pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True). The plan's split comment c-20261022-vs3-split accepts this as the intended refusal at that layer, so it does not hold the node, but the node's own goal text still reads "positive definite for the 12 mm and 6 mm sets".
